reviewer: Codex CLI 0.153.4 (codex exec, default model), independent scripts, no SpanProof code
summary: A second model (Codex CLI) wrote its own reproduction scripts from scratch, without reading or importing SpanProof, and confirmed all 15 claims with controls (full consumption, plain-API baselines, no-Sentry runs). Its qualifications are adopted above: SP-06 is a naive cross-level sum, not proof of double billing; SP-15 is LiteLLM's own normalization; SP-13's missing parent was checked after flush and SDK close. Scripts: review/codex/.

verdicts.SP-01: Confirmed: input/output/total 1200/300/1500, cached and reasoning absent.
verdicts.SP-02: Confirmed: 0 spans after break+close on Chat and Responses; 2 spans when fully consumed.
verdicts.SP-03: Confirmed: 0 spans after abandoning the stream, even after a 2 s grace period.
verdicts.SP-04: Confirmed in Python and JS; the field is declared in openai-python's InputTokensDetails.
verdicts.SP-05: Confirmed: no gen_ai.usage.* keys; .create() on the same response records 2600/2048/512.
verdicts.SP-06: Confirmed (600 vs 300 billed). Qualification: a naive sum across span levels, not double billing.
verdicts.SP-07: Confirmed: inner agent 300 vs its own 200; the extra is the outer agent's first call.
verdicts.SP-10: Confirmed for Python OpenAI; JS OpenAI does record finish reasons.
verdicts.SP-12: Confirmed: input 40, total 2720, no cache attributes.
verdicts.SP-13: Confirmed after flush and SDK close; fully consumed stream delivers the parent.
verdicts.SP-15: Confirmed span value; LiteLLM normalizes the model before Sentry sees it (also without Sentry).
